name: molbic

relevance.justification: Directly aligned with BioThings entity types. Contains 321,086 molecules with InChIKey/SMILES (chemical entities → MyChem.info), 2,666 protein targets with UniProt IDs, 988 cell lines with Cellosaurus IDs, 550,093 cell-based molecular bioactivity records. Structured tabular data with standard identifiers across all entity types.

novelty.justification: First database dedicated to cell-based molecular bioactivities (CMBs) — compound-protein interactions measured within cellular contexts (not purified proteins). This cellular context dimension is not available in ChEMBL, BindingDB, or PubChem BioAssay. Novel fields: CMB values stratified by cell line (988 lines), activity level classification (high/moderate/low: 188K/177K/73K), drug development stage tags (TI/LI/LO/TS), 137 disease classes for cell lines, CCLE/DepMap Cellosaurus IDs. ChEMBL has in vitro data but not cell-based context-specific activity with this granularity.

openness.justification: Freely accessible at molbic.idrblab.net without any login. Paper explicitly states 'now freely accessible without any login requirement'. Download page lists 22 files (txt + sdf archives). Files are publicly accessible. License not explicitly stated on page — likely CC BY-NC 4.0 consistent with other idrblab databases. Compatible with BioThings non-commercial academic deployment.

evidence.scope: Cell-based molecular bioactivity (CMB) database: 550,093 experimentally validated compound-protein bioactivities in cellular contexts, 321,086 unique molecules (SMILES/InChIKey), 2,666 protein targets (UniProt), 988 cell lines (Cellosaurus), 137 disease classes, 25 species. Also includes 60,483 purified protein bioactivities for comparison.
evidence.overlap: Partial overlap: molecule structures (InChIKey/SMILES) overlap with PubChem/ChEMBL; protein targets overlap with UniProt/MyGene. The CMB values with cell-line context are entirely novel. Drug-to-disease and protein-to-disease mappings partially overlap with CTD/DisGeNET but from a CMB perspective.

license.name: CC BY-NC 4.0 (assumed, consistent with other idrblab databases)
restrictions: Non-commercial use only — BioThings academic deployment compatible

risks: MolBiC file URLs contain literal spaces (e.g. '2-1. CMBs_All.txt') — URL encoding fails on this server; requires --path-as-is curl flag or Python requests with unencoded path
License not explicitly stated — assumed CC BY-NC 4.0; confirm before production ingestion
CMBs_All.txt may be large — need to verify file size before streaming
